tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las: lha dbang yongs rdzogs bkol byang bzhugs: 1$0000300hrī: ngo mtshar phun tshogs bde chen zhing: bkod pa tshad med pho brang nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: chos kyi sku yi ngo bo nyid: ye shes snang ba lam me ba: tshe dpag med mgon bcom ldan 'das: yab yum sras dang btsun mo dang: 'dus pa'i 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol: nang gi bar chad nang du sol: gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol: mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i zhing: byang chub chen po'i pho brang nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i ngo bo nyid: dpal ldan pad+ma gar gyi bdag: spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro ba'i mgon: bskal bzang sems dpa' sems ma dang: rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor rnams kyis: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi bar chad= nang gi bar chad= gsang ba'i bar chad= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing: pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sprul pa'i sku yi ngo bo nyid: dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes: snang srid zil gnon thod phreng rtsal: yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang: chos srung rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas kyi: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i=

mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: kā ya a bhi= sku yi ngo mtshar mthong ba'i tshe: g.yas pas ral gri'i phyag rgya mdzad: g.yon pas 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs gyen la gzigs: rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin 'gro ba'i mgon: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma rā dza a nṛ tri dza dza sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: kā ya= dam chos rin chen gsan pa'i tshe: sku gsal 'od zer mdangs dang ldan: phyag g.yas sde snod glegs bam bsnams: g.yon pas phur pa'i pusti bsnams: zab mo'i chos rnams thugs su chud: yang le shod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: kā ya= dam can dam la btags pa'i tshe: dri med gnas mchog nyams re dga': rgya gar bod yul sa mtshams su: byin gyis brlabs nas byon pa'i tshe: dri bsung spos ngad ldan pa'i ri: me tog pad+ma dgun yang skye: chu mig byang chub bdud rtsi'i chu: bde ldan de yi gnas mchog tu: skyes mchog tshul bzang chos gos gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams: g.yon pas rin chen za ma tog: rak+ta bdud rtsis nang du gtams: mkha' 'gro dam can dam la btags: yi dam zhal gzigs dngos grub brnyes: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: kā ya= rgyal ba'i bstan pa btsugs pa'i tshe: g.ya' ri'i nags la sgrub pa mdzad: bsnyen phur nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phar: rdo rje'i phyag rgyas blangs shing bsgril: bsgril shing tsan+dan nags su 'phang: me 'bar 'khrug cing mtsho yang skem: srib kyi mu stegs sa gang bsregs: yak+sha nag po rdul du brlags: 'gran gyi do med bdud kyi gshed: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= srin po'i kha gnon mdzad pa'i tshe: khye'u chung sprul sku'i cha lugs can: ya mtshan gzugs bzang kha dog legs: tshems 'grigs dbu skra ser la mdzes: dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs gsol: phyag g.yas 'khar ba'i phur pa bsnams: bdud dang srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: g.yon pas seng ldeng phur pa bsnams: mos pa'i bu la srung skyob mdzad: mgul na lcags kyi phur pa bsnams: yi dam lha dang gnyis su med: gnyis med sprul sku 'dzam gling rgyan: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: kā ya= 'dre yi yul du dgongs pa'i tshe: me dpung shod kyi sa gzhi la: mda' rgyang gang gi mtsho nang du: pad+ma'i steng du bsil bsil 'dra: pad+ma'i nang na dgongs pa mdzad: mtshan yang pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su byon: de 'dra'i sprul sku ya mtshan can: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs:

dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: kā ya= bod kyi nyi ma mdzad pa'i tshe: dad ldan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal: gang la gang 'dul skur bstan nas: gtsang kha la yi la thog tu: dgra bla'i dge bsnyen dam la btags: yul ni tsha ba'i tsha shod du: lha yi dge bsnyen dregs pa can: nyi shu rtsa gcig dam la btags: mang yul de yi byams sprin du: dge slong bzhi la dngos grub gnang: khyad par 'phags pa'i rig 'dzin mchog: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: kā ya= dpal mo thang gi dpal thang du: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: bod yul kha la'i la thog tu: gangs dkar sha med dam la btags: 'dam shod lha dbu'i snying drung du: thang lha yar bzhur dam la btags: has po ri yi yang gong du: lha srin thams cad dam la btags: che ba'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis: la las srog gi snying po phul: la las bstan pa bsrung bar byas: la las bran du khas blangs byas: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs po che: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru rdo rje gro bo lod lo ka sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: kā ya= dam pa chos kyi bstan pa ni: rgyal mtshan lta bur btsugs pa'i tshe: bsam yas ma bzhengs lhun gyis grub: rgyal po'i dgongs pa mthar phyin mdzad: skyes mchog gsum gyi mtshan yang gsol:

gcig ni pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes: gcig ni pad+ma sam+bha wa: gcig ni mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes: gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= bsam yas mchims phur sgrub pa mdzad: rkyen ngan bzlog cing dngos grub gnang: rje blon thar pa'i lam la bkod: gdon gzugs bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs: chos sku dri med rin chen bstan: skal ldan sangs rgyas sa la bkod: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= de nas o rgyan yul du byon: da lta srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: mi las lhag gyur ya mtshan che: spyod pa rmad byung ngo mtshar che: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs po che: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= sku gsung thugs ldan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal: sgrib pa kun spangs khams gsum sa ler mkhyen: dngos grub mchog brnyes bde chen mchog gi sku: byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad nges par sel: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru pad+ma badz+ra dhū ma gha ye na maḥswā hā:

kā ya= dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo nas: zhe sdang yul 'dzin rnam dag pa: me long lta bu'i ye shes dang: byams pa tshad med ngo bo nyid: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub mdzad pa'i: badz+ra ging chen yab dang yum: rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo dang: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas kyi: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: ha badz+ra dhā ki nī ra badz+ra giṅka ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: dkyil 'khor chen po'i lho sgo nas: ser sna'i yul 'dzin rnam dag pa: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang: snying rje tshad med ngo bo nyid: rgyas pa'i las kun sgrub mdzad pa'i: rat+na ging chen yab dang yum: rin chen rigs kyi dpa' bo dang: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas kyi: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: ri rat+na dhā ki nī tsa rat+na giṅka ra kā ya= dkyil 'khor chen po'i nub sgo nas: 'dod chags yul 'dzin rnam dag pa: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo nyid: dbang gi las kun sgrub mdzad pa'i: pad+ma ging chen yab dang yum: pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' bo dang: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas kyi: thugs rjes 'di la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas 'di yi lam sna drongs: dgongs pas 'di la dngos grub stsol: nus pas 'di yi bar gcod sol: phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: ni pad+ma dhā ki nī hri pad+ma giṅka ra kā ya= dkyil 'khor chen po'i byang sgo nas: phrag dog yul 'dzin rnam dag pa: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang: btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid: drag po'i las kun sgrub mdzad pa'i:
